title: Understudy assist ledger row v1 (REQ-7, CUE-6)
description: One row of data/assist/ledger.jsonl: append-only, local, owned by the worker (view, export, hard delete). One row per skill OCCURRENCE in the 'assist' stream (a step the worker needed in real work, with or without a cue), plus one row per offloaded run in the 'delegated' and 'automation' streams, which are listed as offloaded work and NEVER enter the independence score. Enums, numbers, a coarse hour bucket and id-patterned slugs only: no text, no titles, no names, no paths, no URLs, no screenshots, no field values, no exact timestamps. Ids come from the role pack's vocabulary (skill and step ids) or from the engine (person, routine). A string that does not match its pattern is refused at write time.

person.description: The engine's person id (a slug), never a name.

origin.description: Drives the synthetic badge. Simulated learners and participants are always 'synthetic'.

origin_detail.description: Optional wording for the badge: simulated participants (language model) are not people.

t_hour.description: UTC hour bucket (YYYY-MM-DDTHH). Never a finer timestamp.

skill.description: Pack skill id (or the step id when the pack names no skill). Null only for offloaded rows that map to no skill.

trigger.description: none: the occurrence had no cue at all. auto: Cue spoke on its own. asked: the worker asked.

stuck_bucket.description: Stuck probability bucket (percent) when the first cue was shown.

tier.description: Highest tier reached: 0 none, 1 ring, 2 ring and chip, 3 ghost demo, 4 voice.

options_shown.description: Step options in the question (without the fixed 'something else').

answer_id.description: The option the worker chose: a step id, or 'other'.

accepted.description: The worker accepted a cue, offer or answered a question (explicit, or followed within 10 s).

seconds_to_progress.description: Seconds from the first cue shown to the next progress event; null when there was no cue or no progress.

lost_s.description: Seconds the occurrence took beyond the pack's expert median for that step (negative = faster than the expert median).

outcome.description: clean: completed with no accepted cue. assisted: completed with an accepted cue or answer. error: completed wrongly. abandoned: not completed.

taught.description: The one-line reason (fixed table) was shown on this occurrence: once per skill per day.

retrieval.description: Help was withheld on purpose (retrieval practice scheduled by mastery decay).

routine.description: Offloaded rows only: the routine slug.

minutes.description: Offloaded rows only: minutes of agent work.
